scope: Four native WebSocket clients over loopback, authoritative snapshot comparisons; reconnect, late join, lobby restart and mode switch. These are NOT four browser renderers or a public internet test.

tests.name: Four independent WebSocket clients get identical canonical player IDs, slots and seats
Loaded barrier then one room-owned body starts all four clients on the same run
Every One Body seat alone can move; occupied idle seats do not dilute movement
Canonical world hash/positions agree across all four at common server ticks
Held movement times out and stops when commands stop, without replayed actions
Reconnect restores same ID/slot/seat; four roster entries, not a duplicated fifth
Guest cannot steal occupied seat, change mode, or return everyone to lobby
details: That position belongs to Front. Choose a free position.
Only the host can change the mode, in the lobby.
Only the host can return the whole party. Use Leave room to leave alone.

tests.name: Host returns the whole party, switches to river and restarts a fresh fenced run
Any paddler moves the one shared raft and all four stay aboard
Late rejoin after explicit leave gets the current raft and canonical membership
Wrong game build is explicitly rejected, not admitted to a conflicting room
tests.details: Version mismatch. Open the game from this matching v13 server; do not mix old HTML files or servers.

tests.name: A host disconnect migrates control, without changing the world or shared entity
